meta.sheetTitle: CityMETER Hotel — Venue, Branch & Building Research Master 2026-10-24

unit.row: one row of 01_VENUES — a source-listed accommodation record (CityMETER Hotel V3, TAT accommodation register, official group and property pages, provincial lists); not a field-verified census of operating hotels
unit.rooms: rooms_selected — the room count the sheet selected from its sources; recorded stock, not rooms available per night; unknown stays unknown
unit.price: min/max/avg_price_raw_thb of CityMETER Hotel V3; THB; the source period is unknown; not a current rate, an ADR or revenue

adminMethods.source: CityMETER Hotel V3: the production DISTRICT the source API listed the row under (…/hotel/info/beeSwarm/DISTRICT/{uuid})
adminMethods.name: the row's own district name is a production district of its province
adminMethods.point: the row's selected point lies in a production district of its province (display outline)
adminMethods.conflict: the row's point lies in another province: placed nowhere

meta.districts: CityMETER production base info (lv0/lv1 retrieved 2026-11-01, 78 receipts, sha256 ffe0bf0a5120cf4eb6d832bfeaad9221a5cdafca754348f6b6c6b8bd79bbbe65) + district outlines of data/frames/{CODE}.json

rail.rule: operating = on the operator roster of CityMETER · Transit; construction = a project station, not a service; straight-line distance from the hotel point to the station reference point, up to 2000 m

retail.rule: countable, located venues of the groups listed with status supply; straight-line distance from the hotel point to the venue reference point, up to 1500 m

context.inBuilding: 16_BRANCH_SPATIAL_CANDIDATES qualified spatial_candidate_requires_identity_review: a branch of another CityMETER research dataset whose source point falls in the same research building mass; not a tenancy, floor or located-in claim

brandIdentity.rule: a 01_VENUES brand label is read by its exact 17_BRANDS name; a label without one, or a spelling variant, is read through the brand identity of the research team logo library (its 17_BRANDS ids); labels of one identity count as one brand

limits: Records are source-listed accommodation records; operation is not revalidated (operation_not_revalidated) and the register is not a census.
Rooms are recorded stock; unknown rooms stay out of room totals and are counted apart.
Recorded prices have an unknown source period; they are not current rates, ADR or revenue.
Brands are the brand names the sheet selected with evidence; a record without a brand is not proof of an independent hotel.
Distances to rail stations and retail venues are straight-line distances between reference points.
